independence: Reviewer authored the asset pipeline but did not author or modify ExpeditionScreens.tsx or expedition-screens.css. UI builder repaired reported findings.
parity: Both reviewed files have identical hashes in both repositories.

checks.evidence: Route cards call onChoose(choice.id). Camp buttons dispatch rest or open upgrade/training selectors. Upgrade commits owned deck index. Training maps shop to train-summon, camp to camp-choice/train, treasure to claim-treasure/train. Treasure relic/gold use engine actions; no duplicated frontend mutation.

HP/gold/relic counts are state-derived. Camp healing clamps engine campRecovery to missing HP. Training tiers/descriptions/costs come from trainingOptions/summonTraining, including engine discounts. Treasure values/text come from options/items. Fixed generated concept text is not used for live labels.

Dynamic path-${realm}-${kind} covers all 3 realms and 7 valid route kinds. UI keys match the retained 38-export overlay. First Muster featured seal corrected to exact first-muster-seal ItemId. Other relics use specific existing artwork or data-driven LootIcon rather than reusing seal art.

Native buttons, disabled conditions, pressed state, modal role/title, Escape close, focus restoration, visible focusable filtering including summary and topmost modal guard present. Hidden mastered rows excluded from trap. Clipped roster focus corrected to inset ring/border/brightness.

Hooks remain unconditional at component level. Selected training derives safely from current options when roster changes. Modal close callback stored in ref and keyboard listener cleanup provided. Stable kind/order IDs used for training options.

Mobile single-column cards/training, scrollable modal content and roster, compact height rules, and reduced-motion treatment present. Narrow header rule added after review concern. Root owns actual 320/360/1280 browser geometry and screenshots.

findings.description: Training tile clip-path clipped the shared external focus outline.
findings.repair: Builder added .training-tile:focus-visible inset 3px gold ring, visible border and brightness; re-read final rule.

findings.description: Initial focus selector omitted summary and could include controls hidden in collapsed mastered details.
findings.repair: Builder includes summary, filters getClientRects and inert ancestors, and ignores listeners for lower dialogs.

limitations: This is a static independent UI review, not an independent browser playthrough.
Root owns browser interaction/layout verification and final build/test evidence.
Art approval is inherited only through exact approved-source provenance, not self-approved by this report.
